entry.title: New report shows the economic toll of ICE raids
entry.summary: A new study shows the steep economic cost of 2025's ICE raids in Chicago. Fear kept many immigrants home, draining the area of more than $1.26 billion in lost retail, restaurant, and sales-tax revenue.

entry.title: Many Americans have no memory of 9/11. A foundation hopes an artifact can change that
entry.summary: The Tunnels to Towers Foundation is traveling across the U.S. with a 21-foot I-beam from the World Trade Center's South Tower to help educate Americans with no memory of the Sept. 11 attacks.
